description: Health	The province of Nampula in northern Mozambique is confronting a convergence of climate, health, and conflict-driven crises that threaten public health and social stability. Recurrent cyclones have devastated critical water and sanitation infrastructure, leaving displaced and vulnerable communities reliant on contaminated sources. These conditions have precipitated persistent and severe cholera outbreaks, which disproportionately affect marginalized populations, including internally displaced persons (IDPs). The fragile health and water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) systems are further strained by limited outbreak preparedness, inadequate community hygiene awareness, and weak cross-sector coordination. The project aims to address these needs.
destPlan: Mozambique Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan 2026
